goal.insight: Present a multi-layered visual narrative showing how US-China tariff escalation corresponds with bilateral trade volume shifts and the concurrent rise of alternative supply chain destinations
Emphasize the stepwise escalation pattern of US tariffs on Chinese goods and China's retaliatory tariffs, with key policy events annotated along the timeline
Highlight the rising share of Vietnam and India in US imports over the trade war period, making the acceleration after 2018 visually prominent against China's declining share
Show the trajectory of total US-China bilateral trade volume across the period, emphasizing the dip during peak tariff periods and partial recovery phases
Annotate critical policy milestones (Section 301 investigation, List 1-4 tariffs, Phase One deal, Biden-era reviews) on the timeline to contextualize inflection points in the data
